note: Camera positions are authored review viewpoints chosen for readable architecture, not reconstructions of the exact photographer's position. Where a view imitates a source photograph the match is approximate and recorded as such. CAM_HERO_BRIDGE was added during hero-renders-01 for a river-level view of the crossing; CAM_DISTRICT_OVERVIEW and CAM_KEMBANG_STREET were reframed in the same operation and their recorded targets updated to match the live scene.

CAM_DISTRICT_OVERVIEW.purpose: Whole reconstructed district: readable river corridor, the core crossing and the street network.
CAM_DISTRICT_OVERVIEW.basis: authored review viewpoint; reframed for hero use so the finite ground plane leaves the frame

CAM_PLAN_CHECK.purpose: Near-orthographic plan comparison against the M001 map underlay.

CAM_BRIDGE.purpose: Deck, railings and both banks of Jembatan Merah from the west approach.
CAM_BRIDGE.basis: close to the L006 riverfront relationship; exact photographer position unknown

CAM_INTERNATIO_REFERENCE.purpose: Internatio facade rhythm, parapets and stepped end towers, raised to clear the near foreground massing.
CAM_INTERNATIO_REFERENCE.basis: approximate L004 viewpoint; the raised position differs from the source photograph and the foreground occlusion is acknowledged

CAM_SINGA_REFERENCE.purpose: Singa riverfront arcades, central gabled pavilion and roof sign frame.
CAM_SINGA_REFERENCE.basis: approximate L007 viewpoint from across the river; exact position unknown

CAM_KEMBANG_STREET.purpose: Kembang Djepoen corridor proportions and shophouse rhythm informed by L008.
CAM_KEMBANG_STREET.basis: approximate L008 street-level viewpoint, stood close to the west footway

CAM_FABRIC_OVERVIEW.purpose: Elevated read of the street fabric, block depth and roofscape.

CAM_HERO_BRIDGE.purpose: Jembatan Merah from downstream on Kali Mas, showing the deck span, open railings and both banks.
CAM_HERO_BRIDGE.basis: authored hero viewpoint, not a historical photograph position
